item.description:

But the face of lung cancer has changed. Over the past 15 years, more women, never smokers and younger people are being diagnosed with lung cancer. In fact, lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer death among women , and more women die from lung cancer than breast, ovarian and colorectal cancer each year. The American Lung Association reports that while lung cancer rates have risen by 79% for women over the last 44 years, they decreased by 43% for men . Iran-backed Houthi fighters reportedly hit the headquarters of Saudi Arabia’s national oil company in overnight strikes, stoking a conflict that risks spiralling into a wider war. The attacks follow a Houthi onslaught that killed 13, injured hundreds, and forced Riyadh’s airport to shut at least through Saturday, denting the kingdom’s reputation for stability and piling pressure on the country’s de facto ruler . Analysts fear the conflict could expand beyond the Arabian Peninsula: The Houthis are reportedly building an advanced missile using Chinese parts. US President Donald Trump has accused the group of “ purposefully trying to drive up Oil Prices ” ahead of November’s midterm elections; Tehran is reportedly targeting crude tankers in a bid to keep prices elevated. — Jeronimo Gonzalez

item.title: Hot September CPI Spurs Fed Rate Hike Fears
item.description:
Investors are bracing for the Federal Reserve to again hike interest rates after the Labor Department said Wednesday that consumer prices rose more in September than economists had expected. The inflation report, which comes two weeks before the central bank’s next meeting and three weeks before Election Day, is heightening concerns about the Iran war’s effect on the cost of goods beyond food and energy. With consumer sentiment already nearing a record low, the Trump administration is frantically trying to put a positive spin on the data — and discourage the central bank from acting. Adviser Kevin Hassett told Fox Business it’s a “blip,” while adviser Peter Navarro wrote an editorial on why it proves “the Fed should hold its fire.” All eyes are on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who is slated to speak in Bangkok later this week. — Eleanor Mueller
